seo.title: Wkil | Your AI operator for business and social media
seo.description: Tell Wkil what your business needs. It plans content, writes and publishes posts, replies to customers on WhatsApp, Messenger and web chat, and confirms store orders.
seo.openGraphTitle: Wkil | Tell it what to do. It gets the work done.
seo.openGraphDescription: Your AI teammate for business and social media: content, posts, customer conversations and order confirmation from one chat.

hero.title: Tell Wkil what to do. It gets the work done.
hero.subtitle: Your AI teammate for business and social media. Wkil plans your content, writes and publishes posts, replies to your customers and confirms your store orders. When you ask it for something, it shows you first and acts once you approve.
hero.channels: Works on WhatsApp, Messenger, Facebook comments and web chat.

copilotDemo.ariaLabel: Example of asking Wkil for something in the dashboard
copilotDemo.title: Chat in the dashboard
copilotDemo.request: Prepare next week's post plan for our winter offer.
copilotDemo.reply: Sure. This is the plan I'll prepare, and I need your approval first.
copilotDemo.allowedResult: Done. The plan is ready as a draft for you to review and approve its posts.
copilotDemo.hint: Press Allow or Deny, the way you would in the dashboard.

steps.title: Introduce your business
steps.text: Give it your website link and it reads the site and drafts your business profile. Then add your services, common questions, policies and tone.

steps.title: Connect your channels
steps.text: A WhatsApp number, your Facebook page and Messenger, and web chat. Your number can stay in the WhatsApp Business app while the agent replies alongside it.

steps.title: Tell it what to do
steps.text: From the chat in your dashboard, ask for a content plan, a reply to a customer or a summary of your business. Meanwhile the agent answers customers on your channels.

items.title: A chat that does the work
items.text: From your dashboard, ask it for a business overview, to change the agent's knowledge and settings, to write and send a reply, to update a customer or to generate an image. Any step that changes something waits for your approval.

items.title: Replies to your customers
items.text: On WhatsApp, Messenger and web chat, from what you taught it about your business and in the tone you set. On WhatsApp and Messenger it understands voice notes and images. When someone comments on your Facebook page, it replies and sends them the details in Messenger.

items.title: Hands off and follows up
items.text: When a conversation needs a person, the agent pauses and your team gets a notification. If you turn on follow-ups, it goes back to customers who went quiet at the times you set.

items.title: Prepares and publishes content
items.text: A content plan, written posts and post images. You approve them, they publish or schedule on your Facebook page, and you reply to comments from the same place.

items.title: One inbox for your team
items.text: Every conversation from every channel in one place, with memory for each customer and team notes. Invite your team to the workspace, and follow the inbox, customers and orders from the mobile app.

items.title: Connects to your systems
items.text: Connect the agent to your own systems so it can check a price, availability or order status, or book or cancel something during the conversation.

items.title: Clear reports
items.text: Conversation counts, the share of replies sent by the agent, conversations handed to your team and why, and average reply time.

items.title: If you run more than one business
items.text: Each business gets its own agent profile. Agencies get a manager console that brings client accounts and their reports together, which we turn on with you.

orders.title: And it confirms your store orders on WhatsApp
orders.text: Every new order reaches the customer as a message from your number, with a Confirm and a Cancel button, and its status updates on the orders page.
points: Direct EasyOrders connection, plus any other store that can send orders to a webhook.
Messages go out using Meta-approved templates.
You set the daily limit for new customers, and extra messages wait and go out when the limit resets. If Meta lowers your number's quality, sending stops to reduce the risk of a restriction.

orderDemo.ariaLabel: Example of a WhatsApp order confirmation
orderDemo.message: Hi Sara, we received order 1042: a mug set, EGP 450, cash on delivery. Shall we confirm it?
orderDemo.confirmedReply: Your order is confirmed. We will let you know when it ships.
orderDemo.canceledReply: Your order is canceled. If you change your mind, message us here.
orderDemo.hint: Tap a button in the message, the way a customer would.

chat.title: Try talking to the agent
chat.subtitle: Ask it about Wkil and see how it replies. On your account, the agent answers your customers from what you taught it about your business.
chat.initialMessage: Hi. Ask me what Wkil does, where it replies, or which plan fits you.
prompts: Where does it reply to my customers?
chat.errorText: Could not send your message. Try again.
chat.ctaText: Want the agent answering your customers?

pricing.title: Clear pricing in EGP. Meta fees go straight to Meta.
pricing.subtitle: A conversation is one customer within 24 hours, however many messages they send.
pricing.billingNote: Prices in Egyptian pounds per month. Pay yearly, get two months free, and your price stays fixed for 12 months.

plans.name: Free
plans.tagline: Try Wkil on your website and Messenger
features: Knowledge base for your business (website, services, FAQs)
"Powered by Wkil" badge on the chat

plans.name: Starter
plans.tagline: For the founder who still replies alone
features: 300 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (up to 10 orders a day) with Confirm and Cancel buttons
Automatic follow-ups for customers who went quiet

plans.name: Growth
plans.tagline: For the brand that gets orders every day
features: All channels: WhatsApp + Messenger + web chat
2,000 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (up to 65 orders a day)
Automatic follow-ups + lead capture and memory for every customer
5 users and handoff to your team with a mobile notification
Your own systems: the agent runs actions during the chat

plans.name: Scale
plans.tagline: For several brands or a full team
features: Up to 3 WhatsApp numbers and 3 businesses in one account (two without Meta verification; we set up verification for the third with you)
5,000 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (numbers above 100 confirmations a day need Meta business verification, which we set up with you)
Custom setup with the Wkil team

overage.title: Outgrew your plan this month?
overage.text: We tell you before you reach your plan's limit. After that, extra conversations cost EGP 1 each and extra order confirmations EGP 0.50 each. If your volume keeps growing, cheaper usage packs are available on Growth and Scale: talk to us.

addon.title: Need a second WhatsApp number for a second brand?
addon.text: Add an extra number for EGP 299 a month on Growth or Scale without changing your plan. Each number also gets 1,000 free reply messages a month from Meta.

meta.title: WhatsApp fees go straight to Meta
meta.text: Meta bills your own account directly, with no markup from Wkil: about EGP 0.25 per confirmation message, and about EGP 0.25 per WhatsApp reply after the first 1,000 messages each month. Messenger and web chat carry no Meta fees.

agency.title: Agency, company, or more than 3 numbers?
agency.text: More than 3 WhatsApp numbers, more than 5,000 orders a month, or an agency managing several clients? Custom plans start at EGP 7,999 a month, invoiced by bank transfer.
agency.cta: Sign up and message us inside Wkil

pricing.trialNote: Try the full Growth plan free for 14 days, no card needed, with real confirmations to your customers. Then pick a plan or stay on Free. Cancel any time from your account.

signup.title: Try Wkil on your work
signup.subtitle: Create an account, introduce your business and tell it where to start. The Free plan includes web chat and Messenger.
